reviewNotes: Reviewed all 137 exported speech keys against every field of all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages41-45-tasting.json. Checked contextual topic は → わ and object を → お; no directional へ in these keys. Preserved lexical はなやか, 花・鼻 はな, はちみつ, はく in こはくいろ, はっぽう and はっこう. Read temperatures explicitly: 10–15℃ as じゅうどからじゅうごど, 10–16℃ as じゅうどからじゅうろくど, 60℃ as ろくじゅうど; resolved source duplicated 度 annotation. Read 50% as ごじゅっぱーせんと. Checked ぎんじょう, じゅんまい, ほんじょうぞう, こしゅ, くんしゅ, じゅんしゅ, そうしゅ, じゅくしゅ, ひとはだかん, ぬるかん, きもと, うわだちか, ふくみか and せいまいぶあい against source. Loanwords rendered in hiragana preserving long vowels and punctuation; terminal punctuation supplied. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
